'''Semyon'''{{Efn|Also transliterated as '''Semën'''.<ref name=":0" />}} '''Samsonovich Kutateladze''' ({{langx|ru|Семён Самсонович Кутателадзе}};<ref>{{Cite web |last=Mund |first=Yulia |date=July 21, 2014 |title=В Институте теплофизики СО РАН состоялось торжественное открытие бюста академику Кутателадзе |url=https://www.sbras.info/news/v-institute-teplofiziki-so-ran-sostoyalos-torzhestvennoe-otkrytie-byusta-akademiku-kutateladze |access-date=January 17, 2025 |website={{Ill|Science in Siberia|ru|Наука в Сибири}} |publisher=[[Siberian Branch of the Russian Academy of Sciences]] |language=Russian}}</ref> October 2, 1945 – January 15, 2025) was a Russian mathematician. He was known for his contributions to [[functional analysis]] and its applications to [[vector lattice]]s and [[mathematical optimization|optimization]].<ref name=":0">{{cite journal |last1=Aleksandrov |first1=A. D. |author1-link=Aleksandr Danilovich Aleksandrov |last2=Ladyzhenskaya |first2=O. A. |author2-link=Olga Ladyzhenskaya |last3=Reshetnyak |first3=Yu. G. |author3-link=Yurii Reshetnyak |year=1997 |title=Semën Samsonovich Kutateladze (on his 50th birthday) |url=https://www.turpion.org/php/paper.phtml?journal_id=rm&paper_id=1807 |journal=Russian Math. Surveys |volume=52 |issue=2 |pages=447–450 |bibcode=1997RuMaS..52..447A |doi=10.1070/RM1997v052n02ABEH001807 |mr=1480167 |s2cid=250918620|url-access=subscription }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|mr=2178006
|last1=Gutman|first1=A. E.|last2=Kusraev|first2=A. G.|last3=Reshetnyak|first3=Yu. G.|title=On the nth birthday of Semën Samsonovich Kutateladze for n=60|journal=Sib. Èlektron. Mat. Izv.|volume= 2|year=2005|pages= A.12–A.33|url=https://mi.mathnet.ru/semr48}}</ref> In particular, he made contributions to the [[differential calculus|calculus]] of [[subdifferential]]s for vector-lattice valued functions, to whose study he introduced methods of [[Boolean-valued model]]s and [[infinitesimal]]s.

He was professor of mathematics at [[Novosibirsk State University]],<ref>[https://www.math.nsc.ru/LBRT/g2/ruswin/ssk/ About Kutateladze in Russian]</ref> where he continued and enriched the scientific tradition of [[Leonid Kantorovich]].<ref>{{cite book|first=Lev&nbsp;J.,&nbsp;ed.|last=Leifman|title=Functional analysis, optimization, and mathematical economics: A collection of papers dedicated to the memory of Leonid Vitalʹevich Kantorovich|publisher=The Clarendon Press, Oxford University Press|location=New York|year=1990|pages=xvi+341|isbn=978-0-19-505729-4|mr=1082562}}</ref><ref>Kutateladze, S.S., [https://www.jams.or.jp/notice/Notices0701.pdf "The World Line of Kantorovich"], ''Notices of the ISMS'', International Society for Mathematical Sciences, Osaka, Japan, January 2007.</ref><ref>Kutateladze, S.S., [https://www.math.nsc.ru/LBRT/g2/english/ssk/lvk_phenomenon_e.html "Kantorovich's Phenomenon"], ''Siberian Mathematical Journal<nowiki>''</nowiki>'' (Сибирский мат. журн.), 2007, V. 48, No. 1, 3–4, November 29, 2006.</ref><ref>Kutateladze, S.S., [https://www.math.nsc.ru/LBRT/g2/english/ssk/lvk100_e.html "Mathematics and Economics of Kantorovich"].</ref> His father was the Soviet heat physicist [[Samson Kutateladze]]. Kutateladze died on January 15, 2025, aged 79.<ref>{{Cite web |date=January 17, 2025 |title=15 января скончался заслуженный ветеран СО РАН, д.ф.-м.н., профессор Семён Самсонович Кутателадзе |url=https://math.nsc.ru/news/ftxt/170125a |access-date=January 17, 2025 |website=[[Sobolev Institute of Mathematics]] |language=Russian}}</ref>
